verdict.rationale: Base44's core interaction model is natural language: users describe what they want and the AI builds or updates code, styles, and components. AI agents turn chats into actions inside the app, and Superagents run workflows and web tasks. Independent hands-on reports confirm users built and deployed apps from a few prompts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe what you want in natural language, and AI updates code, styles, and components for you.
Just describe what you want to build, and Base44 will bring your idea to life.
AI agents turn simple chats into actions in your Base44 app.
I quickly built a retirement calculator, two prompts and deploy.
